## Justification
Why do we need this cherry-pick? Describe the user impact and why applying the change separately is necessary.

## Testing
How did you test this change? What automated tests did you add? If you didn't add any new tests, what's your justification for not adding any?

## Validation
- [ ] I've validated this change in a local build or CI
- [ ] Any release or follow-up validation needed for this change is documented
